absent: Subsystem callback contracts for preparation, cancellation, birth, exit, and release, including their locking and sleeping expectations.
Layout and reference rules for membership sets, containers, and clone arguments beyond the fields touched here.
Writability and attach permission evaluation for directed placement.
Freeze trap handling and frozen state aggregation across a container.
Kill generation allocation and the path that initiates container wide termination.
Scheduler deadline bandwidth reservation interaction with placement changes.
Partition validation logic that assigns the diagnostic vocabulary.
Kernfs walk semantics and protection for node private data.
Filter reference handling for socket associated containers.
Ordering between global, threadgroup, set, signal, and placement exclusion outside the fragments shown.
Execution context and ordering guarantees for deferred per processor death processing relative to final release.

findings.text: Fork preparation contract that leaves clone arguments carrying a referenced membership for the child on success and reports failure without leaking references, while delegating per subsystem preparation to registered handlers.

Commit contract for a newly created task that links the child into its prepared membership, refreshes the cgroup namespace root when requested, applies frozen and kill generation policy to ordinary tasks, issues per subsystem birth notifications after linkage, and releases fork time holdings.
Abort contract for failed creation that forwards cancellation to registered handlers for the prepared membership and then drops fork time references and synchronization holdings exactly once.

Membership selection distinguishes inheritance from directed placement: inheritance reuses the caller membership with an added reference and records its kill generation, while directed placement requires a live writable destination chosen by descriptor with attach permission and resolves a combined membership for that destination.

Creation transaction moves through preparation, commitment, and abandonment: preparation secures threadgroup protection and, for directed placement, global protection while pinning memberships; commitment publishes linkage and policy effects; abandonment or successful completion relinquishes the same protections and references.

Fork time exclusion pairs acquisition with release across helpers: threadgroup protection spans preparation until commitment or abandonment, global protection spans the same interval only for directed placement, brief membership sampling uses interrupt safe set exclusion, and freeze marking nests signal exclusion inside set exclusion.

New task policy treats special tasks distinctly: init tasks without an identifier are left unlinked with their prepared membership released, kernel threads bypass freeze and kill generation handling, frozen destinations cause a freeze trap to be recorded, and a kill generation mismatch causes termination after userspace preparation finishes.
Teardown notification contracts forward exit events and release events to the subsystems that registered the corresponding callbacks.

Death detachment removes the task from its membership, maintains the membership population count, parks dying group leaders for iteration, and refreshes deadline and frozen state; one build completes this work inline while another build defers it through a per processor queue drained with task references.

Teardown set exclusion uses interrupt safe protection around unlinking, count maintenance, dying list handling, frozen evaluation, and iterator adjustment, with careful handling of residual linkage during final release.
Death maintains auxiliary container state by decrementing the deadline population for deadline tasks and by refreshing frozen state for ordinary tasks that reside in frozen containers.

Early boot controls adjust availability: a comma separated disable list matches subsystem or feature names, a debug switch enables debug mode through an overridable hook, and a boolean switch records a dynamic modification preference.

Lookup services resolve subsystem state by numeric identity under read side protection, resolve a container by path relative to the caller namespace root with directory and liveness checks, and resolve a container from a descriptor with an optional restriction to the default hierarchy.

Decimal text conversion accepts a whole part with an optional fractional part, rejects malformed input and negative fractions, and scales the outcome to a caller requested decimal shift with rounding to nearest.

Socket association binds a new socket to the creator default container, substitutes the default root when in interrupt context, tolerates cloning from sockets whose containers were removed by taking plain references, and pairs each acquisition of container and filter references with a matching release.

System attribute presentation exposes a delegatable control list that merges base entries with conditionally included pressure entries and per subsystem entries qualified by subsystem name, alongside a fixed capability list, installed as a named group under the kernel object during initialization.
Pressure estimator record comprises an unprocessed event count, a recent output value, a timestamp expressed in seconds, and a spin guard covering those fields.

Placement container embeds subsystem linkage, an option bit word, user requested and effective processor and node masks, exclusive processor views used for partition handling, a prior node mask retained for migration, attach linkage, partition state with remote marking and an unlocked diagnostic code, deadline population with migration reservation accounting, a partition control handle, and optional legacy pressure and domain settings.

Partition diagnostic vocabulary distinguishes success from remote configuration, access failure, housekeeping conflict, empty selection, hotplug interference, missing processor resources, exclusivity violation, non partition use, invalid parent, and invalid processor specification.

Placement option vocabulary provides independent toggles covering page spreading and slab spreading, load balancing, migration on change, hardwall isolation, and separate processor and memory exclusivity.

Control identity vocabulary distinguishes pressure value and pressure enablement, slab and page spreading, domain relaxation, partition selection, balancing, hardwall, memory and processor exclusivity, isolated and effective exclusive and exclusive and subpartition processor views, effective node and processor lists, and base node and processor lists with migration control.

Container derivation converts subsystem linkage to its enclosing placement record with null tolerance, derives task placement through subsystem identity, and derives parent placement through parent linkage.

Placement predicates report online only when online and not dying, test each option independently, detect overlap through effective processor intersection, answer population from a lock guarded query, and derive the instance count from the enable key plus the top instance.

Placement traversal requires the placement mutex for population queries with a dedicated assertion helper, while child and pre order descendant iteration automatically skip records that are not online.
Deadline teardown entry decrements the owning placement deadline population for the supplied task.

Reference lifetime hazards center on balancing acquisitions across success and failure legs for caller and destination and combined memberships, validating descriptor based destinations for liveness and hierarchy before use, and rechecking liveness under protection for path resolution.

Racy policy hazards include a kill generation sampled before commitment and rechecked after linkage to catch an intervening kill request, a freeze indication sampled from the destination and applied after linkage, and a dying leader list whose liveness check must agree with iterator advancement.
Capability vocabulary advertises local process number events, hugetlb accounting, recursive and local memory event behaviors, dynamic modification preference, and delegation support.
System attribute grouping joins a delegate entry with a capability entry under a common cgroup name, terminated to mark the end of the table.
Final task release drops any residual membership linkage after adjusting iterators, then releases the membership reference.
Numeric identity lookup requires read side protection to be held by the caller.
Lookup and socket association hold read side protection across pointer sampling and live reference acquisition with retry when racing removal is observed.
